ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across approximately 85% of the visible surface, with low-intensity (black) pigments localized at the center and periphery.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions covering the majority of the lateral lobes. A central, vertical black region widening at the base. High-contrast black borders along the trailing edges and tips. Sparse black punctate mottling scattered across the white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp, well-defined vertex angle of approximately 35-45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serrations across the entire span of the trailing edge, featuring sharp peaks and varying pixel-depth valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges tapering to distal tips with an overall S-curve trailing edge geometry.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, irregular white and brown calcified structures (barnacles) located on both the left and right distal tips. Minor circular dark spots on the interior ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, parallel diagonal dark linear marks (rake marks) in the lower left quadrant of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle encrustation on both outer lobe tips; multiple small healed dark scars/spots visible on the white ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive black 'drip' or streak markings extending from the trailing edge into the white field on the right lobe.
